newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai prime minister leaves for Vietnam visit.
newsitem.headline: Thai prime minister leaves for Vietnam visit.

text.p: Thailand's Prime Minister Chavalit Yongchaiyudh left on Sunday for a two-day official visit to Vietnam, a government spokesman said.
Varathep Ratanakorn told reporters that the premier will promote trade and economic cooperation between the two countries during the visit.
Thailand would like to boost its trade with Vietnam which last year stood at $646.8 million. It will also seek business cooperation with Vietnam, especially in the field of fishery, he said.
Chavalit will inform Hanoi during the visit that Thailand is ready to support Vietnam in building the Vietnamese section of Highway Nine which willl link Thailand, Laos and Vietnam, he said.
